dct_description_sm: This polygon shapefile shows built up areas (areas containing a concentration of buildings and other structures) in the Republic of the Congo. The data is created from 'LANDSAT ETM+' image which the GLCF project of the Maryland state university offers, Vmaplevel0, and the geographic information in which acquisition at spot is possible.
Global Map data were developed under the cooperation of National Geospatial Information Authorities (NGIAs) of respective countries and regions.
